snippet.title: VR Forensic Science Simulation - VR Crime Scene Investigation
snippet.description:
First, a huge thank you and job well done to the BCIT media team who produced this video. You can find their credits at the end of the video. 

Forensic EduSim™ was developed by Envision Innovative Solutions originally for Burlington County Institute of Technology's Law and Public Safety program, specifically their forensic science curriculum. Students, in Virtual Reality (VR) or on mobile devices, can explore a forensic crime scene and implement proper and standard practices of photography, evidence collection and processing, victim identification and coroner removal. Experience data is recorded for post-experience instructor assessment. 

Forensic EduSim™ has since been adopted by other schools in New Jersey with Law and Public Safety programs.

Interested in our AR or VR services? Please drop us a note at xr@envision-is.com or visit Envision-IS.com/XR
